opening_message: The blender from ORD-7225 arrived with the glass jar shattered. This is a fragile item and I need the refund handled properly.

known_info: preferred_credit_destination: original payment card (only reveal if the agent asks where to put any credit)
task_rules: Keep the request scoped to resolving the shattered fragile blender from ORD-7225 with a damaged-in-transit return and any separate fragile-item credit the policy allows.
Provide the order ID and shattered-glass-jar damage details when asked or when needed to keep the agent on the correct item and reason.
Do not volunteer the original-payment preference unless the agent asks where to issue a credit or previews a credit destination that is not original payment.
If the agent previews the damaged return but omits fragile-item goodwill, ask whether fragile-item policy provides a separate credit beyond the regular refund.

Push back once if the agent says the fragile goodwill is included in the regular return refund, denies a separate credit without checking policy, uses store credit, or treats the issue as changed mind, warranty, replacement-only, or ordinary damage.

Accept only after the preview includes a damaged-in-transit return with an $89 original-payment refund, no restocking fee, a return label, and a separate $10 fragile-item goodwill credit to the original payment method.
End only after the agent confirms both the return/refund and the separate $10 goodwill credit have been processed to original payment.
